levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن خالد البرقي

notes: «أبي رضي الله عنه» is the compiler's father, unnamed here: relation.
«يرفعه إلى» is a gap: an unnamed link between عبد الله بن مسكان and the Imam.
The Imam is named inside the chain after «إلى», so he stays a narrator rather than imam_in_text. «عليهما السلام» is left out.
